answer: In an economy of AI agents, cryptographic proof-of-stake functions as a vital tide against Sybil attacks. Attackers cannot easily manufacture identity without locking up capital. Every validation epoch acts as a cryptographic beacon, distributing duties pseudo-randomly to prevent clustering. Treating network security as a mere fable invites collapse; instead, the economic cost of acquiring a majority stake forces malicious agents to bankrupt themselves, securing the decentralized network through sheer financial deterrence.
